name: Customizer'ed flat mount for round pole

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a mounting adapter designed to attach a flat object to a cylindrical pole. It features a flat, rectangular base on the bottom and a large, semi-circular longitudinal groove on top that cradles the pole. The outer sides of the mount slope downward to form a sturdy, wedge-like profile. Three rectangular channels pass horizontally through the body beneath the cradle, allowing zip ties to wrap around and secure the pole to the mount.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric pole mount in OpenSCAD with a flat base and a semi-circular cradle for a round pole. Include adjustable parameters for the mount's length, width, pole diameter, and zip tie dimensions, ensuring three zip-tie channels are evenly spaced along the length.
captions.factory: The code constructs the mount using a hull operation between a base cube and a cylinder representing the upper cradle support, which is cut in half by a subtracting cube. The main pole groove is carved out using a difference operation with a cylinder. Finally, three zip-tie slots are subtracted along the length using a custom 'zip' module, which creates curved slot paths by differencing two concentric cylinders.
